post.description: Sends 'unlock' command to the selected Tedee Lock

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description:
Unlock mode:

0 - (or no parameter set) - Normal. From close position: unlock only or unlock with auto pull if enabled. From open position: nothing.
2 - Force. Force movement until lock hits resistance.
3 - Without Pull. From close position: unlock only without auto pull. From open position: nothing.
4 - Unlock or Pull. From close position: unlock only or unlock with auto pull if enabled. From open position: pull.

get.summary: List PINs on a Tedee Lock
get.description: Returns all PINs stored on the selected Tedee Lock (up to the lock's full capacity). Only id and alias are returned per entry. Large lists are streamed using HTTP chunked transfer-encoding, so the response may not carry a Content-Length header. The lock returns about 5 PINs per BLE message and each message takes about 1 second, so 100 PINs take about 20 seconds and 250 PINs about 45 seconds. Set the client timeout per read rather than for the whole response. The Bridge handles one local API request at a time, so other requests wait until the list is complete. Pass the listVersion from the previous response to get 304 Not Modified instead of the full list when nothing has changed.

304.description: the list has not changed since the listVersion given in the request; no body

406.description: device reported an error via BLE interface

409.description: another PIN operation is in progress on this lock, either another local API request or the Tedee app through the cloud; retry later

id.description: PIN identifier assigned by the lock

alias.description: Human-readable label, up to 32 bytes UTF-8 (the lock's limit)

startDate.description: Validity start date as Unix timestamp (0 = unbounded)

endDate.description: Validity end date as Unix timestamp (0 = unbounded)

dayStartTime.description: Daily access window start, seconds from midnight (0 = unbounded)

dayEndTime.description: Daily access window end, seconds from midnight (0 = unbounded)

weekdays.description: Weekday bitmask: bit 0=Mon … bit 6=Sun. 0x7F (127) = every day.

pin.description: PIN code, 5–8 decimal digits (the lock rejects shorter codes)

alias.description: Human-readable label, up to 32 bytes UTF-8 (the lock's limit); required, may be empty

startDate.description: Validity start date as Unix timestamp (0 or omitted = unbounded)

endDate.description: Validity end date as Unix timestamp (0 or omitted = unbounded). Must be greater than startDate when both are non-zero, otherwise 400.

dayStartTime.description: Daily access window start, seconds from midnight 0–86399 (0 or omitted = unbounded)

dayEndTime.description: Daily access window end, seconds from midnight 0–86399 (0 or omitted = unbounded). Must be >= dayStartTime when both non-zero.

weekdays.description: Weekday bitmask: bit 0=Mon … bit 6=Sun. 0x7F (127) = every day. Defaults to 127.

PinUpdate.description: Request body for PUT /lock/{deviceId}/pin/{pinId}. All fields replace the existing PIN record.

pin.description: PIN code, 5–8 decimal digits (the lock rejects shorter codes)

alias.description: Human-readable label, up to 32 bytes UTF-8 (the lock's limit)

endDate.description: Validity end date as Unix timestamp (0 = unbounded). Must be greater than startDate when both are non-zero, otherwise 400.

listVersion.name: listVersion
listVersion.description: listVersion from a previous response. When it matches the lock's current version the Bridge answers 304 Not Modified without a body. Omit it or pass 0 to always get the full list.
